metadata.note: Fix was initially incomplete — setCustomHttpHeaders() in storage.service.ts was a second injection point not addressed in the first pass. Both injection points now fixed (2026-07-31T14:00:00Z).

changes_made: 1. src/app/services/logger.service.ts — AuthTokenServerService.alterHttpRequest(): removed the Authorization: Bearer token header injection. Method now returns the unmodified httpRequest directly. Dead getAuthToken() method (unreachable after fix) also removed.

2. src/app/services/storage.service.ts — StorageService.setConnected(): removed the secondary setCustomHttpHeaders(new HttpHeaders({Authorization: Bearer token})) call that also forwarded the session token to the ngx-logger interceptor chain. Unused HttpHeaders import removed.

files_modified.changes: alterHttpRequest() returns httpRequest unchanged; dead getAuthToken() removed.
setCustomHttpHeaders() call removed from setConnected(); HttpHeaders import removed.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: Bearer token header injection fully removed from both injection points: alterHttpRequest() in AuthTokenServerService and setCustomHttpHeaders() in StorageService.setConnected(). The credential is now strictly scoped to the ApplinX API session and cannot reach the log infrastructure.
secondary_controls: Dead getAuthToken() method removed from AuthTokenServerService to eliminate any possibility of future re-introduction.

validation_criteria: No Authorization header present in ngx-logger remote log HTTP requests after login.
setConnected() navigates to 'instant' without calling setCustomHttpHeaders().
HttpHeaders is not imported in storage.service.ts.
